fullContentHtml:
UPSSSC Technical Assistant Group C AGTA Eligibility Result 2026 - Complete Details

Short Information : Uttar Pradesh Subordinate Services Selection Commission (UPSSSC) has released a eligibility result for the recruitment of Agriculture Technical Assistant (AGTA) Group-C posts on the official website of UPSSSC. This recruitment was released for 2759 posts. Applications for the UPSSSC Agriculture Technical Assistant AGTA Group-C Recruitment 2026 were accepted from 22 May 2026, to 11 June 2026. Candidates who had applied this form can download their UPSSSC Technical Assistant Group C AGTA Eligibility Result 2026 from the link given below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 22 May 2026
  • Last Date : 11 June 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 11 June 2026
  • Correction Last Date : 18 June 2026
  • Eligibility Result Available : 02 July 2026
  • Exam Date : Notify Soon
  • Admit Card Available : Before Exam

Application Fee

  • General, EWS, OBC : Rs. 25/-
  • SC, ST, Candidates : Rs. 25/-
  • PH Candidates: Rs. 25/-
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.

How to Check Result

  1. Visit the official website.
  2. Click on the result / scorecard link.
  3. Enter your application number / roll number and date of birth / password.
  4. Click on submit to view your result.
  5. Download and take a printout of the scorecard for future reference.
